messages:
elena: Quick Q — the reranker endpoint contract is still ambiguous about score semantics. Are we returning raw logits, normalized probs, or a signed confidence in [-1,1]? This affects quota units and console visuals. @jamal any preferences?

jamal: We left it flexible early on. Ops needs a canonical unit for billing/routing. My vote: normalized [0,1] probabilities + an explicit `score_type` field so downstream can rely on units.

saira: Agree on explicit type. Also: what counts as a billable unit? We currently bill per-candidate scored (candidate-units). If teams start returning logits the perceived value changes.

jamal: Example response I'm proposing:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "score": 0.87},
    {"id": "c2", "score": 0.12}
  ],
  "score_type": "prob",
  "model": "rescorer-v2",
  "score_meta": {"scale": "[0,1]", "method": "softmax"}
}
```

oscar: Console needs to surface: avg normalized score, model fanout counts, cost per candidate, and fallback/unhealthy rate. For rollouts we need automatic regression alerts (score drift, latency).

jamal: Fallback policy idea: if primary model fails, fallback model rescoring returns `fallback_applied: true` and we add `score_anchor` so callers can detect systematic bias and optionally rescale. Also include a header `X-Estimated-Cost` with estimated units.

elena: Telemetry checklist: per-request latency histogram, per-candidate score distribution histogram, sampled prompt+candidate blobs for offline eval. Also per-model KL/divergence vs baseline.

saira: On quotas: propose canonical unit `candidate_units` = num_candidates * model_cost_factor. Default model_cost_factor=1 for baseline models; bigger for heavy models. Add `estimated_cost` in response body or headers for transparency.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: rescorer-v2 -> canary window 2026-03-21T09:00Z. Traces will be tagged `model.canary=true`.

oscar: UX ask: console rollout page should let product toggle score_display between "prob"/"logit" and show conversion formula (e.g., softmax -> logits). Also quick links to calibration docs.

jamal: Plan: open spec PR with contract + migration plan + console mockups. Proposed enum for `score_type`: ["prob","logit","rank_score"], require `score_meta.scale` and `method`. Migration flag `accept_legacy_scores=true` for 6 weeks to ease transition.

elena: Add automatic gating: compute KL-divergence between canary and baseline score distributions; if KL > 0.1 OR mean score shift > 0.05, auto-roll back canary. Also emit alert to #incidents.

saira: :+1: I'll add dashboard tiles for candidate_units per route and fallback_rate over time.

jamal: Opening PR now, tagging @elena and @saira for review. Will include sample telemetry queries and console screenshots.
